verses.original: יִצְחָ֛ק אֶֽל־ וַיִּקְרָ֥א יַעֲקֹ֖ב וַיְבָ֣רֶךְ אֹת֑וֹ לֹֽא־ תִקַּ֥ח אִשָּׁ֖ה כְּנָֽעַן׃ מִבְּנ֥וֹת וַיְצַוֵּ֙הוּ֙ וַיֹּ֣אמֶר ל֔וֹ
verses.transliteration: yiṣ·ḥāq ’el- way·yiq·rā ya·‘ă·qōḇ way·ḇā·reḵ ’ō·ṯōw lō- ṯiq·qaḥ ’iš·šāh kə·nā·‘an mib·bə·nō·wṯ way·ṣaw·wê·hū way·yō·mer lōw
verses.literal: So Isaac . . . called for Jacob and blessed him Do not take a wife from the Canaanite women he commanded . . .

verses.original: לֵךְ֙ ק֥וּם פַּדֶּ֣נָֽה אֲרָ֔ם בֵּ֥יתָה אִמֶּ֑ךָ אֲבִ֣י בְתוּאֵ֖ל וְקַח־ לְךָ֤ מִשָּׁם֙ אִשָּׁ֔ה מִבְּנ֥וֹת לָבָ֖ן אִמֶּֽךָ׃ אֲחִ֥י
verses.transliteration: lêḵ qūm pad·de·nāh ’ă·rām bê·ṯāh ’im·me·ḵā ’ă·ḇî ḇə·ṯū·’êl wə·qaḥ- lə·ḵā miš·šām ’iš·šāh mib·bə·nō·wṯ lā·ḇān ’im·me·ḵā ’ă·ḥî
verses.literal: Go at once vvv to Paddan-aram to the house of your mother’s father Bethuel and take - a wife from among the daughters of Laban your mother’s brother

verses.original: וְאֵ֤ל שַׁדַּי֙ יְבָרֵ֣ךְ אֹֽתְךָ֔ וְיַפְרְךָ֖ וְיַרְבֶּ֑ךָ וְהָיִ֖יתָ לִקְהַ֥ל עַמִּֽים׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’êl šad·day yə·ḇā·rêḵ ’ō·ṯə·ḵā wə·yap̄·rə·ḵā wə·yar·be·ḵā wə·hā·yî·ṯā liq·hal ‘am·mîm
verses.literal: May God Almighty bless you and make you fruitful and multiply you so that you may become a company of peoples

verses.original: וְיִֽתֶּן־ לְךָ֙ אֶת־ בִּרְכַּ֣ת אַבְרָהָ֔ם לְךָ֖ וּלְזַרְעֲךָ֣ אִתָּ֑ךְ לְרִשְׁתְּךָ֙ אֶת־ אֶ֣רֶץ מְגֻרֶ֔יךָ אֲשֶׁר־ אֱלֹהִ֖ים נָתַ֥ן לְאַבְרָהָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·yit·ten- lə·ḵā ’eṯ- bir·kaṯ ’aḇ·rā·hām lə·ḵā ū·lə·zar·‘ă·ḵā ’it·tāḵ lə·riš·tə·ḵā ’eṯ- ’e·reṣ mə·ḡu·re·ḵā ’ă·šer- ’ĕ·lō·hîm nā·ṯan lə·’aḇ·rā·hām
verses.literal: And may He give - the blessing of Abraham to you and your descendants . . . so that you may possess - the land where you dwell as a foreigner the land God gave to Abraham

verses.original: יִצְחָק֙ אֶֽת־ וַיִּשְׁלַ֤ח יַעֲקֹ֔ב וַיֵּ֖לֶךְ פַּדֶּ֣נָֽה אֲרָ֑ם אֶל־ לָבָ֤ן בֶּן־ בְּתוּאֵל֙ הָֽאֲרַמִּ֔י אֲחִ֣י רִבְקָ֔ה אֵ֥ם יַעֲקֹ֖ב וְעֵשָֽׂו׃
verses.transliteration: yiṣ·ḥāq ’eṯ- way·yiš·laḥ ya·‘ă·qōḇ way·yê·leḵ pad·de·nāh ’ă·rām ’el- lā·ḇān ben- bə·ṯū·’êl hā·’ă·ram·mî ’ă·ḥî riḇ·qāh ’êm ya·‘ă·qōḇ wə·‘ê·śāw
verses.literal: So Isaac - sent Jacob . . . vvv to Paddan-aram to Laban son of Bethuel the Aramean the brother of Rebekah [who was] the mother of Jacob and Esau

verses.original: עֵשָׂ֗ו וַיַּ֣רְא כִּֽי־ יִצְחָק֮ אֶֽת־ בֵרַ֣ךְ יַעֲקֹב֒ וְשִׁלַּ֤ח אֹתוֹ֙ פַּדֶּ֣נָֽה אֲרָ֔ם לָקַֽחַת־ ל֥וֹ אִשָּׁ֑ה מִשָּׁ֖ם בְּבָרֲכ֣וֹ אֹת֔וֹ וַיְצַ֤ו עָלָיו֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר לֹֽא־ תִקַּ֥ח אִשָּׁ֖ה כְּנָֽעַן׃ מִבְּנ֥וֹת
verses.transliteration: ‘ê·śāw way·yar kî- yiṣ·ḥāq ’eṯ- ḇê·raḵ ya·‘ă·qōḇ wə·šil·laḥ ’ō·ṯōw pad·de·nāh ’ă·rām lā·qa·ḥaṯ- lōw ’iš·šāh miš·šām bə·ḇā·ră·ḵōw ’ō·ṯōw way·ṣaw ‘ā·lāw lê·mōr lō- ṯiq·qaḥ ’iš·šāh kə·nā·‘an mib·bə·nō·wṯ
verses.literal: Now Esau learned that Isaac - had blessed Jacob and sent him vvv to Paddan-aram to take a wife there vvv vvv commanding him . . . Do not marry . . . a Canaanite woman

verses.original: יַעֲקֹ֔ב וַיִּשְׁמַ֣ע אֶל־ אָבִ֖יו וְאֶל־ אִמּ֑וֹ וַיֵּ֖לֶךְ פַּדֶּ֥נָֽה אֲרָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ya·‘ă·qōḇ way·yiš·ma‘ ’el- ’ā·ḇîw wə·’el- ’im·mōw way·yê·leḵ pad·de·nāh ’ă·rām
verses.literal: and that Jacob had obeyed . . . his father . . . and mother and gone vvv to Paddan-aram

verses.original: עֵשָׂ֔ו וַיַּ֣רְא כִּ֥י אָבִֽיו׃ יִצְחָ֥ק רָע֖וֹת בְּעֵינֵ֖י כְּנָ֑עַן בְּנ֣וֹת
verses.transliteration: ‘ê·śāw way·yar kî ’ā·ḇîw yiṣ·ḥāq rā·‘ō·wṯ bə·‘ê·nê kə·nā·‘an bə·nō·wṯ
verses.literal: And seeing that his father Isaac disapproved of . . . the Canaanite women

verses.original: עֵשָׂ֖ו וַיֵּ֥לֶךְ אֶל־ יִשְׁמָעֵ֑אל וַיִּקַּ֡ח אֶֽת־ מָחֲלַ֣ת׀ אֲח֧וֹת נְבָי֛וֹת בַּת־ אַבְרָהָ֜ם בֶּן־ יִשְׁמָעֵ֨אל עַל־ לְאִשָּֽׁה׃ס נָשָׁ֖יו ל֥וֹ
verses.transliteration: ‘ê·śāw way·yê·leḵ ’el- yiš·mā·‘êl way·yiq·qaḥ ’eṯ- mā·ḥă·laṯ ’ă·ḥō·wṯ nə·ḇā·yō·wṯ baṯ- ’aḇ·rā·hām ben- yiš·mā·‘êl ‘al- lə·’iš·šāh nā·šāw lōw
verses.literal: Esau went to Ishmael and married - Mahalath the sister of Nebaioth [and] daughter of Abraham’s son Ishmael in addition to the wives . . . he already had

verses.original: יַעֲקֹ֖ב וַיֵּצֵ֥א מִבְּאֵ֣ר שָׁ֑בַע וַיֵּ֖לֶךְ חָרָֽנָה׃
verses.transliteration: ya·‘ă·qōḇ way·yê·ṣê mib·bə·’êr šā·ḇa‘ way·yê·leḵ ḥā·rā·nāh
verses.literal: Meanwhile Jacob left Beersheba and set out for Haran

verses.original: וַיִּפְגַּ֨ע בַּמָּק֜וֹם וַיָּ֤לֶן שָׁם֙ כִּי־ הַשֶּׁ֔מֶשׁ בָ֣א וַיִּקַּח֙ מֵאַבְנֵ֣י הַמָּק֔וֹם וַיָּ֖שֶׂם מְרַֽאֲשֹׁתָ֑יו וַיִּשְׁכַּ֖ב הַהֽוּא׃ בַּמָּק֥וֹם
verses.transliteration: way·yip̄·ga‘ bam·mā·qō·wm way·yā·len šām kî- haš·še·meš ḇā way·yiq·qaḥ mê·’aḇ·nê ham·mā·qō·wm way·yā·śem mə·ra·’ă·šō·ṯāw way·yiš·kaḇ ha·hū bam·mā·qō·wm
verses.literal: On reaching a certain place he spent the night there because the sun had set And taking one of the stones from that place he put it under his head and lay down vvv to sleep

verses.original: וַֽיַּחֲלֹ֗ם וְהִנֵּ֤ה סֻלָּם֙ מֻצָּ֣ב אַ֔רְצָה וְרֹאשׁ֖וֹ מַגִּ֣יעַ הַשָּׁמָ֑יְמָה וְהִנֵּה֙ אֱלֹהִ֔ים מַלְאֲכֵ֣י עֹלִ֥ים וְיֹרְדִ֖ים בּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·ḥă·lōm wə·hin·nêh sul·lām muṣ·ṣāḇ ’ar·ṣāh wə·rō·šōw mag·gî·a‘ haš·šā·mā·yə·māh wə·hin·nêh ’ĕ·lō·hîm mal·’ă·ḵê ‘ō·lîm wə·yō·rə·ḏîm bōw
verses.literal: And [Jacob] had a dream about a ladder that rested on the earth with its top reaching up to heaven . . . and God’s angels were going up and down [the ladder]

verses.original: וְהִנֵּ֨ה עָלָיו֮ יְהוָ֜ה נִצָּ֣ב וַיֹּאמַר֒ אֲנִ֣י יְהוָ֗ה אֱלֹהֵי֙ אָבִ֔יךָ אַבְרָהָ֣ם וֵאלֹהֵ֖י יִצְחָ֑ק אֶתְּנֶ֖נָּה וּלְזַרְעֶֽךָ׃ הָאָ֗רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֤ר אַתָּה֙ שֹׁכֵ֣ב עָלֶ֔יהָ לְךָ֥
verses.transliteration: wə·hin·nêh ‘ā·lāw Yah·weh niṣ·ṣāḇ way·yō·mar ’ă·nî Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê ’ā·ḇî·ḵā ’aḇ·rā·hām wê·lō·hê yiṣ·ḥāq ’et·tə·nen·nāh ū·lə·zar·‘e·ḵā hā·’ā·reṣ ’ă·šer ’at·tāh šō·ḵêḇ ‘ā·le·hā lə·ḵā
verses.literal: And there at the top the LORD was standing and saying I am the LORD the God of your father Abraham and the God of Isaac I will give you and your descendants the land on which you now lie . . . . . .

verses.original: זַרְעֲךָ֙ וְהָיָ֤ה כַּעֲפַ֣ר הָאָ֔רֶץ וּפָרַצְתָּ֛ יָ֥מָּה וָקֵ֖דְמָה וְצָפֹ֣נָה וָנֶ֑גְבָּה כָּל־ מִשְׁפְּחֹ֥ת הָאֲדָמָ֖ה וְנִבְרֲכ֥וּ בְךָ֛ וּבְזַרְעֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: zar·‘ă·ḵā wə·hā·yāh ka·‘ă·p̄ar hā·’ā·reṣ ū·p̄ā·raṣ·tā yām·māh wā·qê·ḏə·māh wə·ṣā·p̄ō·nāh wā·neḡ·bāh kāl- miš·pə·ḥōṯ hā·’ă·ḏā·māh wə·niḇ·ră·ḵū ḇə·ḵā ū·ḇə·zar·‘e·ḵā
verses.literal: Your descendants will be like the dust of the earth and you will spread out to the west and east and north and south All the families of the earth will be blessed through you and your offspring

verses.original: וְהִנֵּ֨ה אָנֹכִ֜י עִמָּ֗ךְ וּשְׁמַרְתִּ֙יךָ֙ בְּכֹ֣ל אֲשֶׁר־ תֵּלֵ֔ךְ וַהֲשִׁ֣בֹתִ֔יךָ אֶל־ הַזֹּ֑את הָאֲדָמָ֖ה כִּ֚י לֹ֣א אֶֽעֱזָבְךָ֔ עַ֚ד אֲשֶׁ֣ר אִם־ עָשִׂ֔יתִי אֵ֥ת אֲשֶׁר־ דִּבַּ֖רְתִּי לָֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hin·nêh ’ā·nō·ḵî ‘im·māḵ ū·šə·mar·tî·ḵā bə·ḵōl ’ă·šer- tê·lêḵ wa·hă·ši·ḇō·ṯî·ḵā ’el- haz·zōṯ hā·’ă·ḏā·māh kî lō ’e·‘ĕ·zā·ḇə·ḵā ‘aḏ ’ă·šer ’im- ‘ā·śî·ṯî ’êṯ ’ă·šer- dib·bar·tî lāḵ
verses.literal: Look I am with you and I will watch over you wherever - you go and I will bring you back to this land For I will not leave you until - - I have done - what I have promised you

verses.original: יַעֲקֹב֮ וַיִּיקַ֣ץ מִשְּׁנָתוֹ֒ וַיֹּ֕אמֶר אָכֵן֙ יְהוָ֔ה יֵ֣שׁ הַזֶּ֑ה בַּמָּק֖וֹם וְאָנֹכִ֖י לֹ֥א יָדָֽעְתִּי׃
verses.transliteration: ya·‘ă·qōḇ way·yî·qaṣ miš·šə·nā·ṯōw way·yō·mer ’ā·ḵên Yah·weh yêš haz·zeh bam·mā·qō·wm wə·’ā·nō·ḵî lō yā·ḏā·‘ə·tî
verses.literal: When Jacob woke up . . . he said Surely the LORD is in this place and I vvv was unaware of it

verses.original: וַיִּירָא֙ וַיֹּאמַ֔ר מַה־ נּוֹרָ֖א הַזֶּ֑ה הַמָּק֣וֹם זֶ֗ה אֵ֣ין כִּ֚י אִם־ בֵּ֣ית אֱלֹהִ֔ים וְזֶ֖ה שַׁ֥עַר הַשָּׁמָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yî·rā way·yō·mar mah- nō·w·rā haz·zeh ham·mā·qō·wm zeh ’ên kî ’im- bêṯ ’ĕ·lō·hîm wə·zeh ša·‘ar haš·šā·mā·yim
verses.literal: And he was afraid and said How awesome [is] this place This is none other than . . . the house of God this is the gate of heaven

verses.original: וַיַּשְׁכֵּ֨ם בַּבֹּ֗קֶר יַעֲקֹ֜ב וַיִּקַּ֤ח אֶת־ הָאֶ֙בֶן֙ אֲשֶׁר־ וַיָּ֥שֶׂם מְרַֽאֲשֹׁתָ֔יו אֹתָ֖הּ שָׂ֣ם מַצֵּבָ֑ה וַיִּצֹ֥ק שֶׁ֖מֶן עַל־ רֹאשָֽׁהּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yaš·kêm bab·bō·qer ya·‘ă·qōḇ way·yiq·qaḥ ’eṯ- hā·’e·ḇen ’ă·šer- way·yā·śem mə·ra·’ă·šō·ṯāw ’ō·ṯāh śām maṣ·ṣê·ḇāh way·yi·ṣōq še·men ‘al- rō·šāh
verses.literal: Early the next morning Jacob took - the stone that he had placed under his head - and he set it up as a pillar He poured oil on top of it

verses.original: וַיִּקְרָ֛א אֶת־ שֵֽׁם־ הַה֖וּא הַמָּק֥וֹם בֵּֽית־ אֵ֑ל וְאוּלָ֛ם לָרִאשֹׁנָֽה׃ הָעִ֖יר שֵׁם־ ל֥וּז
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·rā ’eṯ- šêm- ha·hū ham·mā·qō·wm bêṯ- ’êl wə·’ū·lām lā·ri·šō·nāh hā·‘îr šêm- lūz
verses.literal: and he called - - that place vvv Bethel though previously the city had been named Luz

verses.original: יַעֲקֹ֖ב וַיִּדַּ֥ר נֶ֣דֶר לֵאמֹ֑ר אִם־ אֱלֹהִ֜ים יִהְיֶ֨ה עִמָּדִ֗י וּשְׁמָרַ֙נִי֙ הַזֶּה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אָנֹכִ֣י הוֹלֵ֔ךְ בַּדֶּ֤רֶךְ וְנָֽתַן־ לִ֥י לֶ֛חֶם לֶאֱכֹ֖ל וּבֶ֥גֶד לִלְבֹּֽשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: ya·‘ă·qōḇ way·yid·dar ne·ḏer lê·mōr ’im- ’ĕ·lō·hîm yih·yeh ‘im·mā·ḏî ū·šə·mā·ra·nî haz·zeh ’ă·šer ’ā·nō·ḵî hō·w·lêḵ bad·de·reḵ wə·nā·ṯan- lî le·ḥem le·’ĕ·ḵōl ū·ḇe·ḡeḏ lil·bōš
verses.literal: Then Jacob made a vow saying If God will be with me and watch over me on this - - . . . journey and if He will provide me with food to eat and clothes to wear

verses.original: וְשַׁבְתִּ֥י בְשָׁל֖וֹם אֶל־ אָבִ֑י בֵּ֣ית יְהוָ֛ה וְהָיָ֧ה לִ֖י לֵאלֹהִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: wə·šaḇ·tî ḇə·šā·lō·wm ’el- ’ā·ḇî bêṯ Yah·weh wə·hā·yāh lî lê·lō·hîm
verses.literal: so that I may return safely to my father’s house then the LORD will be my God

verses.original: הַזֹּ֗את וְהָאֶ֣בֶן אֲשֶׁר־ שַׂ֙מְתִּי֙ מַצֵּבָ֔ה יִהְיֶ֖ה אֱלֹהִ֑ים בֵּ֣ית וְכֹל֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר תִּתֶּן־ לִ֔י עַשֵּׂ֖ר אֲעַשְּׂרֶ֥נּוּ לָֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: haz·zōṯ wə·hā·’e·ḇen ’ă·šer- śam·tî maṣ·ṣê·ḇāh yih·yeh ’ĕ·lō·hîm bêṯ wə·ḵōl ’ă·šer tit·ten- lî ‘aś·śêr ’ă·‘aś·śə·ren·nū lāḵ
verses.literal: And this stone - I have set up as a pillar will be God’s house and of all that You give me I will surely give You a tenth . . . . . .
